Web · /board-sizes · Wisconsin Creative

Board Sizes, internal

Board Sizes is now an internal layout reference: board sizes, zones and drawings, without the delivery instructions written for outside partners.

Side by side

Before is the working tree as it stood at the start of this change (HEAD 4a1b0178 plus the uncommitted redesign). After differs only by this cut. Both use the same manifest (2026-10-08.1), Chromium, light mode, 1× scale and the same viewport and clip.

What changed, and why

Venue delivery callout

Was

Deadlines, who designs full-system pieces, and how partners deliver.

Now

Removed. That's guidance for outside partners.

Delivery pills and sources

Was

fps, codec, stills, dpi and audio on every card, plus a Sources row and a provenance line under each drawing.

Now

Removed from the page. boards.json, index.json and llms.txt still carry every field.

Notes

Was

Display and zone notes mixed layout facts with file naming, audio specs and who designs what.

Now

Only open issues show. The drawing's overlays already show scrims, crops and seams, and pad tags keep their tooltip.

Share link

Was

Primary button; the toast warned about hiding the way back to the site.

Now

Plain button, toast just says Link copied.

Verification

  • tests/static-tools.test.ts: 46 passed
  • node scripts/hash-static-tools.mjs: app.js restamped
  • npm run verify:docs and git diff --check: pass
  • No page errors in any capture (Playwright pageerror listener)

Things to know

  • Content types, Game day, For agents & tools and Open issues are still in the sidebar; dropping or demoting them is a separate call.
  • Pre-existing: zone labels overlap in the North Board drawing where the wings stack (Wing Short / Ad-Middle / Wing-Left).
  • Not done: search by id or key, and Back-button history.
